config.title: QRadar Health Check Assessment
next_steps: Within 7 days: remediate the 6 critical finding(s), starting with CPU utilisation on qr-console01, CPU utilisation on qr-ep01, Disk usage /var/log on qr-dn01.
Within 30 days: address the 14 high-severity finding(s) and validate the results in a follow-up health check.
Within 60 days: complete medium-priority tuning (log source clean-up, WinCollect standardisation, application updates).
Schedule a follow-up QRadar health check after remediation, and quarterly thereafter.
Review the capacity plan against the licence forecast and agree an upgrade path for QRadar software and apps.
